capabilities: sync highlights and comments from a Kavita server
create book notes grouped by chapter with colored callouts
link highlights to exact reader locations in Kavita
generate a library view of books as cover cards using a Bases base
customize highlight output with a template with live preview
disambiguation: Not a vault or file sync; it only imports reading highlights from a Kavita server into notes.
extras: The plugin is read-only toward Kavita, stores the auth key in Obsidian's secret storage, sends no telemetry, and preserves user content under a My notes heading across syncs. A troubleshooting guide is linked rather than fully inline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull highlights and notes out of a Kavita ebook server into the vault.

relations.evidence: Bring your reading highlights and notes from Kavita into Obsidian

requires.name: Kavita user account with an auth key

summary: Syncs reading highlights and annotations from a self-hosted Kavita server into linked, per-book notes.
